name: CachyOS Layer
description: Turn Ryoku into CachyOS: the performance-tuned CachyOS kernel (EEVDF with sched-ext, Clang ThinLTO and AutoFDO, the Cachy patchset, x86-64-v3), the cachyos-settings system tuning, the sched-ext schedulers, the ananicy-cpp auto-nice daemon and its CachyOS ruleset, and the CachyOS Proton build. Installing it adds the CachyOS repositories and signing key above the Arch repos, so pacman -Syu tracks CachyOS's optimized rebuilds and its pacman fork: opting in means going full CachyOS. Your stock Arch kernel stays installed as the safe fallback (pick it at the boot menu to roll back). Install all for the whole layer, or pick individual tools. Every item except scx-scheds needs the CachyOS repo; scx-scheds is in Arch extra and runs on plain Arch too.

items.name: linux-cachyos
items.summary: The CachyOS kernel: EEVDF with sched-ext, Clang ThinLTO and AutoFDO, the Cachy patchset, x86-64-v3. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

items.name: linux-cachyos-headers
items.summary: Headers for the CachyOS kernel, needed to rebuild DKMS modules (NVIDIA, VirtualBox) against it. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

items.name: cachyos-settings
items.summary: CachyOS system tuning: sysctl, udev, modprobe and systemd defaults for a responsive desktop. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

items.name: ananicy-cpp
items.summary: Auto-nice daemon that reprioritizes processes so the compositor and foreground apps stay responsive under load. From the CachyOS repo (AUR on plain Arch).

items.name: cachyos-ananicy-rules
items.summary: The CachyOS ruleset ananicy-cpp applies. Needs the CachyOS repo; not on plain Arch.

items.name: scx-scheds
items.summary: sched-ext userspace schedulers (bpfland, rusty, lavd). In Arch extra, so it runs on plain Arch too; it just shines on the CachyOS kernel.

items.name: proton-cachyos-native
items.summary: The CachyOS-tuned Proton build for Steam and Lutris. Needs the CachyOS repo (and multilib for its 32-bit libraries); not on plain Arch.
